title: Movie review: ‘Sense and Sensibility’ gives Jane Austen’s romance a darker edge
summary: The 2026 adaptation of Jane Austen’s ‘Sense and Sensibility’ takes a darker, more Gothic approach to the classic romance, setting it apart from Ang Lee’s celebrated 1995 film.
